openings.claim: Unreliable storage addresses may explain delays. Retain surname shelves, dividers and cart; turn the behind-desk exception slip into a movement-updated locator linking requesting reader, book and current location, including household-surname placements. Consult it before searching elsewhere. Fast cart pickups challenge mandatory shelving as an accelerator.
openings.discriminator: Accurate entries with fewer second searches support locator repair. Unchanged searches defeat the retrieval mechanism. Accurate addresses with little searching but burst-concentrated delays favor clerk congestion; identification problems remain a rival. The cart counterexample weakens if its advantage disappears after matching volume and book size.
openings.probe: First rehearse displaced-book moves and locator retrieval; then compare comparable evening pickups with and without updates. Use only the existing clerk, paper, pencils, timing sheet, two shelves and return cart; add no furniture. Keep names and contact details behind the desk. Record arrival, service start, retrieval, completion, location accuracy and second searches; verify reservation and recipient identity at handoff. Count all preparation and correction work toward ten daily clerk-minutes, record update effort and stop at the cap.
openings.uncertainty: A reliable reader-to-book identity source is unverified. Updating every movement within budget and consulting during bursts remain unproven. Cart volume/size effects and interview representativeness are unknown. Rehearsal cannot establish evening queues or handoff correctness. All observations are synthetic stipulations; no improved effect is established.

lineage.reason: Retains address hypothesis, cart counterexample, controlled comparison and burst rival.
Retains movement-linked mechanism, rehearsal boundary, qualification defeats and feasibility assumptions.

decision: Probe the conditional repair. Qualification requires at least 95% of available pickups within two minutes during the stipulated evening window, zero wrong-reader handoffs, no identity exposure and every hard constraint. Fewer searches alone do not qualify; missed targets, any wrong handoff or excess preparation defeat qualification.
